name: Research Report
description: Deep-research any question across multiple sources and write a cited report.
trigger: research a question / topic across sources and write a report

steps.label: Search broadly
steps.instruction: Break the question into 3-5 sub-questions/angles and run a brave-search for each (its search parameter is `q`) — gather diverse, credible, recent sources. Do NOT rely on a single search.

steps.label: Cross-check for breadth
steps.instruction: Run 1-2 web searches (serper) to corroborate and catch anything recent the first pass missed.

steps.label: Synthesize
steps.instruction: Cross-reference the findings across sources; resolve disagreements and note uncertainty/confidence. Reason this out yourself — no service call.

steps.label: Write the cited report
steps.instruction: Write a structured markdown report: a short summary, then sections answering the question, then a Sources list with links. Cite sources inline where claims come from them.
